notes.title: Patch Notes for Apr 1
notes.content:
fix: Merchant can be killed by Erratic Essence!
fix: Mages are fleeing combat after nearly dying then running back into the fight...
update: Reduced the number of footsteps that will be played at once
update: Mage management windows will load large amounts of data over multiple frames
update: Massive optimizations on large numbers of mages and enemies to keep framerates above 60 in large battles
fix: Several internally silenced crash bugs that could impact speed
fix: Tutorial pointer getting confused on building vs researching
fix: Window frames can be dragged off-screen
fix: Merchant window not allowing scrolling only key press
fix: Mages that are removed from the game from death allow the Mage Window to stay open causing all sorts of errors
fix: Mouse cursor staying active when in controller mode causing confusion
fix: Several grammatical issues in the tutorial
fix: Selecting rooms with the controller is awkward when the last room is off screen
fix: Game is starting with 0 volume on the master channel
update: New UI tip when trying to build over a locked room in the tutorial
update: Top left HUD design expanded to fit long research names
fix: Order panel text is a mess with long item names
add: New tip for promotions!
fix: Controller button guidance failing to map correctly on New Game - Pick Your Mages
fix: Selecting rooms with the controller when rooms are far apart requires too much precision

notes.title: Quick Portal Fix
notes.content: Fixed a display issue with the Portal duplicating the selected items for sale!

notes.title: Quick Patch for Feb 8, 2024
notes.content:
Thanks for all the feedback! I've got a few quick things to make demo plays a little smoother:
fix: Renaming wizards intermittently starts the game when using the spacebar
fix: Crafting special order tooltip is not displaying allowed orders or that you've reached max orders
update: Auto-order base limit has been increased to 4 from 1
update: Auto-order limits for administration office have been doubled
fix: Typo in Inferno Cannon Powder
fix: New game scaling incorrectly on Ultrawide monitors cutting off traits for mages

notes.title: Quick Patch!
notes.content:
fix: Custom Mode was able to select unavailable spawning difficulties causing enemies to fail spawning
fix: Mage Tooltip incorrectly highlight traits with the wrong colours
fix: Mages who fled from combat were going back in and running away again getting extremely unhappy!
fix: Autoassign fails when the data service wasn't available
fix: Crafting check if any rooms are making sub-recipes intermittently failing
fix: Current task assignment intermittently failing for the Essence Reaper
fix: Rejecting a candidate from the headhunting intermittently failing
fix: Promoting mages with the option to auto-increase their food/drink could fail to find the data service
fix: Candidates fleeing can fail to find the data service

notes.title: Small fix + more sound
notes.content:
Quick changes: 
[list]
[*] fix: Overlapping text when finishing researching in the HUD for research
[*] add: New sound for the merchant cart when moving
[*] add: New mapping for sounds with the game speed at x2 + x3
[*] add: More sounds when different rooms complete building: Erratic Shield, Clinic, God Maker, Admin Office, Shield Room, Munitions, Panic Room
[*] add: Ambient sounds for a few more rooms: Erratic Shield, Admin Office, Dining Room
[/list]

notes.title: Quick update!
notes.content:
As mentioned on the Discord server there are a couple updates/fixes/additions:
[list]
[*] add: New interactions between different damage types!
[*] fix: Mages shouldn't flee just because the tower is under attack and the mage is currently hurt
[*] update: Mages that have fled should get back to work after 30 minutes even if the tower is still under attack
[*] fix: Clinic task is working but the mages are not being healed
[*] add: Clicking, shift+clicking, and control+clicking the craft options will increase the amount selected - Thanks A790!
[*] fix: Survival Mode - Repairing is far too slow
[*] update: Survival Mode - Absorbing enemies will give double the gold
[*] fix: Dead mages are haunting the tower and not disappearing
[*] update: Wraiths can no longer be stunned or frozen but still take extra damage from lightning
[*] fix: Missing icons for the effects shown on the enemies window
[/list]
